about: Agent City art pack. Every picture, sound and layout file the office uses, one folder per kind of thing, each labelled here. Code finds files by name through this catalog, so a file can be replaced in place and goes live on the next publish. Read README.md in this folder first.

folders.label: Positions
folders.about: layout.json says where everything is: desks, seats, monitors, the dogs' paths, boats' lanes, lamps, masks, sprite cells. Coordinates are 0..1 of the room (1280 x 720) unless noted.
folders.edit: Edit by hand for small moves. Desks and seats are generated by portable/art/run-scene.js (scene.js PLAN and DESKS), so change those there.

layout.json.label: Where everything is (positions, sprite cells, masks, lanes)

folders.label: Room pictures (the painted office)
folders.about: The whole office as one painting, at dusk and at night, in two sizes (-hi for screens wider than 2560 px). Everything that does not move is in here: walls, floor, desks, chairs, kitchen, shelves, bean bags, and the city and river through the window. nochair-*: patches that paint a seat without its chair, for empty seats.
folders.edit: Do not repaint by hand: run node portable/art/run-scene.js <out-dir> --install, which rebuilds the four plates, the masks and layout.json together. The four plates must stay the same picture; dusk and night line up pixel for pixel.

plate-dusk-hi.webp.label: The office at dusk, high resolution (big screens)

plate-night-hi.webp.label: The office at night, high resolution (big screens)

nochair-dusk.webp.label: Empty-seat patches without chairs, dusk (cells: layout.json nochair)

folders.label: Cut-outs (masks)
folders.about: Shapes that cut one part out of the room picture, so it can be drawn in front of or behind moving things. White is the part. Same frame as the plates.
folders.edit: Made by the scene builder together with the plates. If something moves in the room picture, its mask has to move with it.
